subject: Guard NULL replica_primary_host in Sentinel INFO handling (#4929)
reason: The change is a NULL guard in sentinel.c's sentinelRefreshInstanceInfo, code that executes only inside a valkey-server process running in Sentinel mode (--sentinel / valkey-sentinel) while it polls INFO from a monitored replica whose reported master_host is unset (freed by sentinelResetPrimary after a failover, or not yet parsed). The fuzzer cannot reach it: its deployment modes are only standalone and cluster (the architecture doc lists Sentinel mode as not implemented), valkey.action.commands starts its private servers as plain valkey-server with a config file and Sentinel mode cannot be ena
